notes.title: The Mod Update
notes.notes:
Hi all, we have some new releases for Skin Deep!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]1. Mod Museum[/h1]
New release! The Skin Deep design team has made a series of maps that take you on a guided tour behind-the-scenes of the game. This tour will explain how various things work, such as lighting, clambering, scripting, and more, in a variety of interactive exhibits. This is a free workshop item.

[h2]👉[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3485308806]Click here to check out the Mod Museum![/url][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775836/4b370986031ff889a02ec981ccd372394f5b93f7.png[/img]

[h1]2. Skin Deep Mod Handbook[/h1]
New release! The Skin Deep design team has written up a guide for getting up and running with making mods for the game. Some of us got our game development start in modding, so we're very happy to continue the tradition here.

[h2]👉[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3478108275]Click here to check out the guide![/url][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775836/0a201b6c4f28bfcf195b63b0863b012bfc7f06a1.png[/img]

[h1]3. Skin Deep workshop uploader[/h1]
New release! This tool allows you to upload Skin Deep mods to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/301280/workshop/]Steam workshop[/url]. This tool is free and available to everyone who has Skin Deep.

Just search your Steam Library for: [i]Skin Deep workshop uploader[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33775836/50543c273abe2865f676bf1ef4d05a234a65f896.png[/img]

[h1]4. Skin Deep accolades trailer[/h1]
New release! We've made a new trailer video that shares some of the nice things being said about Skin Deep. Thank you all for your support!

[h2]👉[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u3F2hCGCoTI]Click here to check out it out![/url][/h2]
[previewyoutube=u3F2hCGCoTI;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
Thank you all so much for your support. We have more updates and fixes on the way. Stay tuned!

To view past game updates, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/301280/view]click here[/url].
